description: This Java class implements an Android InputMethodService (custom keyboard) that allows users to insert images (GIF, PNG, WebP) into text input fields via commitContent API. It manages image files, checks support for content types, and handles content sharing with proper permissions.

classes.name: ImageKeyboard
classes.description: Custom Android IME service enabling image insertion via commitContent API, managing image files, permissions, and UI buttons.

methods.name: isCommitContentSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current input editor supports a specific MIME type for content insertion.

methods.name: doCommitContent
methods.description: Prepares and commits image content (GIF, PNG, WebP) to the input connection with proper permissions.

methods.name: validatePackageName
methods.description: Validates the package name of the target application for security.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes image files from raw resources.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates the input view with buttons to insert different image types.

methods.name: onEvaluateFullscreenMode
methods.description: Disables full-screen mode for the IME.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Enables or disables image insertion buttons based on support.

methods.name: getFileForResource
methods.description: Loads raw resource images into files for sharing.
